component.name: OPTIC
component.summary: Control your TV from your PC

description.p: Open source desktop remote for Android TV, Google TV, Roku, LG webOS and Samsung Tizen. It talks straight to the TV over your local network: no extra hardware, no cloud, no account.
Controle remoto de código aberto para Android TV, Google TV, Roku, LG webOS e Samsung Tizen. Fala direto com a TV pela rede local: sem hardware extra, sem nuvem, sem conta.
